Home.description: GaneshLab Consultation is a comprehensive project management platform designed to streamline your consulting journey. Our system connects clients with expert consultants (PICs) through structured workflows, appointment scheduling, and collaborative project tracking.

features.calendar: Appointment scheduling with Google Calendar integration
features.milestone: Milestone tracking for project workflow management

Home.dataUsageText1: We collect and use your information to provide consulting services, schedule appointments, and manage projects. Your Google Calendar data is used solely for appointment coordination and will never be shared with third parties. All personal data is protected under our privacy policy and handled in compliance with data protection regulations.
Home.dataUsageText2Part2: for detailed information about data collection and usage.
Home.clientsNoteTail: Schedule a consultation to get started and receive login access to our platform
Home.guestsNoteTail: Book an appointment directly without creating an account

informationWeCollect.title: 1. Information We Collect
informationWeCollect.content: We collect personal information such as your name, email, and profile data when you register. For calendar integration, we may access your Google Calendar data with your consent.

howWeUse.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
howWeUse.content: Your information is used to provide consultation services, manage chats, projects, and calendar availability. We do not share your data with third parties without your consent.

dataSecurity.title: 3. Data Security
dataSecurity.content: We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access.

contactUs.title: 4. Contact Us
contactUs.content: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at support@ganeshlab-consultation.com.

serviceAvailability.content: We strive to provide continuous service but do not guarantee uninterrupted access. We reserve the right to modify or discontinue services.
